title: New environment never starts
briefing: You cloned the production environment to make a staging one. Deployment fails immediately.

artifacts.logs: eb-engine.log shows the instance deployment successfully generated a Procfile, but the application fails during startup.

options.text: Set the SECRET_KEY environment property on the staging environment and redeploy
Hardcode a SECRET_KEY into settings.py and commit it
options.why_wrong: Secrets in Git are leaked secrets. Configuration belongs in the environment.

options.text: Switch the environment to a bigger instance type
options.why_wrong: The app crashes at import time. Resources are not the issue.
The traceback points to a missing setting, not a version problem.

explanation: The settings module deliberately fails when SECRET_KEY is missing. The staging environment has not configured the required secret.
lesson: When identical code works in one environment but fails in another, compare the configuration first.
hints: Read the last line of the traceback.
What is different between staging and production?
